summary: Tested MEALUR Coming Soon landing page - both backend (waitlist API) and frontend (UI/integration). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (root, subscribe valid/duplicate/case-insensitive/invalid/missing/empty, stats count, stats increment). Frontend: All UI flows verified - hero heading, subtext, countdown timer with 4 ticking cards, right visual, email form (empty/invalid validation, valid submit success state + toast, duplicate submit 'already on the list' toast), mobile (390px) responsiveness with preserved hierarchy.

issues: 'Get Early Access' CTA label wraps onto 3 lines next to the input on small screens; consider stacking input above button or shortening label on mobile for cleaner look. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is initialized AFTER it is referenced inside subscribe_waitlist's except block (lines 78 vs 107). If insert ever fails, this will raise NameError shadowing the real DB error. Move logging.basicConfig + logger=getLogger(__name__) above route definitions (just after imports).
server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager for forward compatibility.

EmailForm.jsx: after a successful submit, the form is permanently disabled (status='success' never resets). Re-submitting requires a full page reload, so the 'duplicate email toast on resubmit' UX only works after reload. Consider resetting status to 'idle' after a few seconds or on input change.
RightVisual.jsx: '412 foodies already on the list' is hardcoded; could be wired to /api/waitlist/stats for authenticity.
server.py: unique index creation on email is best-effort (try/except warn). Existing duplicates (case differences from before normalization) could cause silent failures - acceptable for greenfield.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_/ui_test_ prefixed waitlist entries during testing (no cleanup endpoint exists; harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py covers all endpoints. Target launch date is 2026-07-31 - countdown will tick down. Frontend uses sonner toasts (selector: [data-sonner-toast]). EmailForm permanently locks into success state after first submit; reload needed to re-test. All data-testids are wired correctly: hero-heading, hero-subtext, countdown-timer, countdown-card-{days|hours|minutes|seconds}, email-form, email-input, get-access-button, email-error, right-visual, site-header, site-footer, page-root, brand-logo.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches spec.
